messages.content: 流行歌曲中最常見的和弦是什麼？

function.name: music_theory_primary_triads

message.content: 在流行音樂（Pop）中，最常見的和弦通常是「主音（I）」「屬七（V7）」「下屬七（ii7）」「下屬（ii）」「下屬七（iii7）」「下屬（iii）」「下屬七（iv7）」「下屬（iv）」「下屬七（v7）」「下屬（v）」「下屬七（vi7）」「下屬（vi）」「下屬七（vii°7）」「下屬（vii°）」等。這些和弦在不同調式中會有不同的名稱，例如在C大調中，I為C、V7為G7、ii7為Dm7、iii7為Em7、iv7為Fmaj7、v7為Am7、vi7為Bm7、vii°7為Cdim7。這些和弦在流行音樂中被廣泛使用，並且可以組成許多經典的和弦進行，例如「I–V–vi–IV」或「I–vi–IV–V」。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "流行歌曲中最常見的和弦是什麼？" which translates to "What are the most common chords in pop songs?" They want an answer. We can provide a general explanation: In pop music, the most common chords are I, V, vi, IV (the "50s progression") and I–vi–IV–V. Also secondary dominants, ii–V–I, etc. But the question might be answered with a list of chord types: major, minor, dominant seventh, etc. Provide examples. Also mention that many pop songs use diatonic chords from the key, especially I, IV, V, vi. Also mention that some use borrowed chords like bVII, bIII, etc.

We should respond in Chinese. Provide a concise answer. No need to call the function.
